# 2 Clement — Chapter 5 (EMET Literal)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 5
**Agent:** EMET (Literal)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Therefore, brothers, having left behind our sojourning in this world, let us do the will of the one who called us, and let us not fear going out of this world.
2. For the Lord said: "You will be as lambs in the midst of wolves."
3. But Peter, answering, said to him: "What if the wolves tear apart the lambs?"
4. Jesus said to Peter: "After their death, let the lambs not fear the wolves. And you — do not fear those who kill you and can do nothing more to you; but fear the one who, after your death, has authority over soul and body, to cast them into the fire of Gehenna."
5. And you know, brothers, that the sojourning of this flesh in this world is brief and transitory, but the promise of Christ is great and wonderful — it is rest in the kingdom that is coming and in eternal life.
6. What then must we do to obtain these things, except to live in a holy and righteous manner, and to consider these worldly things as foreign to us and not desire them?
7. For in desiring to obtain these things we fall away from the right path.
